title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper… (CVE-2026-80284)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an improper authentication vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to potentially expose sensitive data and modify system operations without authorization. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.7.
